name: Suley's Store
subtitle: Roblox kits I build myself. Every kit comes with the full source code, and you buy it straight through my Discord.

perks.title: You get the full source
perks.text: Nothing is locked or obfuscated, so you can read every script and change whatever you want.

perks.title: Free updates
perks.text: When I improve a kit you get the new version for free, all the way until the next big version.

perks.title: Easy to set up
perks.text: Each kit comes with a setup guide, so you can get it running in Studio without guessing.

perks.title: I actually help
perks.text: If something breaks or you get stuck, message me on Discord and I’ll help you sort it out.

products.name: Bluelock Kit V1
products.short: The base for your own Bluelock-style football game.
products.description: This is the football system I use for Bluelock-style games. You get ball control, shooting, passing and abilities already working, so you can focus on building your game instead of the core mechanics. Everything is open source, I help you set it up, and you get free updates until V2 comes out.

products.name: Emote Bar V1
products.short: A full emote framework your players can use right away.
products.description: A complete emote system for your game. Players open the emote bar, pick an emote and it plays. Adding your own emotes is easy, it works on mobile, and I help you set it up. You also get free updates until the next version comes out.
features: Easy to add your own emotes

faq.q: How do I buy a kit?
faq.a: Join the Discord and open a ticket, or just DM me. Tell me which kit you want, pay, and I send it to you right after.
You can pay with Robux, through a gamepass, or with cash for some kits. Each kit shows which options it has.
Yes, updates are free until the next version of the kit comes out. I post them in the Discord.

faq.q: Do I need to know how to script?
faq.a: Not really. Every kit comes with a setup guide, and if you get stuck I’ll help you on Discord.

faq.q: Can I resell or share a kit?
faq.a: No. You can use it in your own games as much as you want, but please don’t leak or resell the files.
Since kits are files, I can’t take them back once they are sent. If something doesn’t work, I’ll fix it for you.
